location.en: Daybreak Coffee head office, meeting room

goal.en: Respond to a price objection and keep the deal alive.
goal.zh: 回應客戶對價格的疑慮，讓這筆生意繼續談下去。

background: modern cafe company meeting room with a long reclaimed wood table, two coffee cups, exposed brick wall, hanging edison bulbs, large industrial windows, gray rainy afternoon

intro.en: Two weeks later. The trial went well, and Daybreak has your quote. This time, their finance director has joined the meeting.
intro.zh: 兩週後。試用很順利，破曉咖啡也拿到了你的報價。這次，他們的財務總監也加入了會議。

intro.en: Kai, my staff loved the trial lights. But Ms. Novak has some questions.
intro.zh: 凱，我的員工都很喜歡試用的燈。不過諾瓦克女士有些問題。

intro.en: I'll be direct. I've read your quote very carefully.
intro.zh: 我就直說了。你的報價我看得很仔細。

lines.en: Your price is almost twice what we pay for regular LED bulbs. Frankly, that's too expensive.
lines.zh: 你們的價格幾乎是我們買一般 LED 燈泡的兩倍。坦白說，太貴了。

choices.en: I understand your concern. May I show you what's included in that price?
choices.zh: 我理解您的顧慮。我可以說明一下這個價格包含了哪些項目嗎？
choices.tip: I understand your concern. 先接住對方的情緒，再引導到價值說明。

choices.en: It's not expensive at all. You just don't understand what our product can really do yet.
choices.zh: 一點也不貴。您只是還不了解我們的產品真正能做什麼。

lines.en: I understand numbers perfectly well, thank you.
lines.zh: 我對數字的理解很清楚，謝謝。

story.en: Ms. Novak closes her folder with a quiet snap. Mr. Reyes suddenly finds his coffee very interesting.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士「啪」的一聲輕輕闔上資料夾。雷耶斯先生突然對他的咖啡很感興趣。

fail.why: 直接反駁「一點也不貴」，再暗示對方不懂，會讓客戶覺得被冒犯。先表示理解：I understand your concern.，再說明價值。

choices.en: I understand you concern. But the price is include installation and the five years warranty.
choices.zh: 我理解您的顧慮。但這個價格包含安裝和五年保固。

lines.en: The price is include...? Sorry, is installation included or not?
lines.zh: 價格是包含……？抱歉，到底有沒有包含安裝？

story.en: Ms. Novak asks you to put everything in writing, twice. A finance director does not like guessing.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士要你把所有內容寫成書面，而且說了兩次。財務總監最不喜歡用猜的。

fail.why: your concern 要用所有格 your；「包含」說 The price includes...，不是 is include；五年保固是 a five-year warranty。財務相關的說明一定要清楚準確。

lines.en: Even so, our lighting budget for this year is fixed. I can't just find extra money.
lines.zh: 就算如此，我們今年的照明預算是固定的。我沒辦法憑空變出錢。

choices.en: That makes sense. Let's look at the long-term savings. The system pays for itself in about two years.
choices.zh: 可以理解。我們來看看長期能省下的費用。這套系統大約兩年就能回本。
choices.tip: Let's look at the long-term savings. 把焦點從「現在花多少」轉到「長期省多少」。

choices.en: I see. By the way, how is your new downtown cafe doing? I heard the opening was really popular.
choices.zh: 了解。對了，你們市中心的新店經營得如何？聽說開幕時很熱門。

lines.en: It's doing fine. Now, back to the budget, please.
lines.zh: 還不錯。現在，請回到預算的話題。

story.en: Changing the subject does not make the objection disappear. Ms. Novak simply asks the same question again, more slowly.
story.zh: 轉移話題不會讓客戶的疑慮消失。諾瓦克女士只是把同樣的問題再問一次，而且說得更慢。

fail.why: 客戶提出預算疑慮時轉移話題，會像在逃避。正面回應，把焦點轉到長期效益：Let's look at the long-term savings.。

choices.en: Then just give me some face this time, okay? Next time I'll give you a better price, I promise.
choices.zh: 那這次就給我個面子，好嗎？下次我一定給你們更好的價格。

lines.en: Give you... a face? I'm sorry, I don't follow. And why not a better price now?
lines.zh: 給你……一張臉？抱歉，我聽不懂。而且為什麼不現在就給更好的價格？

story.en: Ms. Novak hears only one thing: a better price exists. She now wants it today.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士只聽懂了一件事：原來還有更好的價格。現在她要求今天就拿到。

fail.why: 「給我面子」直譯成 give me face，英文母語者聽不懂，「下次給更好的價格」還會讓對方以為你現在有保留。用長期效益說服：Let's look at the long-term savings.。

lines.en: Two years is a long time. How can I be sure those savings are real?
lines.zh: 兩年很長。我要怎麼確定那些節省是真的？

choices.en: Fair point. I'd be happy to share the meter data from your trial cafe, so you can check it yourself.
choices.zh: 您說得有道理。我很樂意提供試用分店的電表數據，讓您自己核對。
choices.tip: Fair point. 承認對方的質疑合理，再拿出對方能自己驗證的數據。

choices.en: I promise you one hundred percent. If you don't save money, I will personally pay you the difference.
choices.zh: 我百分之百保證。如果沒省到錢，我個人補差額給您。

lines.en: Personally? I'd rather have data than a personal promise.
lines.zh: 你個人？比起個人承諾，我寧願要數據。

story.en: Ms. Novak writes down your offer, just in case. You spend the evening checking your savings account.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士把你的承諾記了下來，以防萬一。你整晚都在查自己的存款餘額。

fail.why: 業務用個人名義做無法兌現的保證，會顯得不專業又不可信。財務主管要的是證據：I'd be happy to share the meter data from your trial cafe.。

choices.en: You can believe me. Our customer all say the saving is very obvious and they are very satisfy.
choices.zh: 您可以相信我。我們的客戶都說省很多，而且非常滿意。

lines.en: Very satisfy? I'll need more than that, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 非常滿意？恐怕我需要的不只這些。

story.en: "Trust me" is not a number. Ms. Novak asks for three written references before the next meeting.
story.zh: 「相信我」不是數字。諾瓦克女士要求下次開會前提供三份書面推薦。

fail.why: customer 要用複數 customers；「滿意」是形容詞 satisfied，不是 satisfy。更重要的是，要用對方能驗證的數據說服，而不是只說「相信我」。

lines.en: Our old supplier was cheaper, though. Why shouldn't we just stay with them?
lines.zh: 不過我們原本的供應商比較便宜。為什麼不乾脆繼續用他們？

choices.en: That's certainly an option. The difference is that our system also cuts maintenance, so the total cost is lower.
choices.zh: 那當然也是一個選擇。差別在於我們的系統也能減少維修，所以總成本更低。
choices.tip: That's certainly an option. 先尊重對方的選擇，再用「總成本」說明差異。

choices.en: Because we are friends now, right? Friends should support each other's business, don't you think so?
choices.zh: 因為我們現在是朋友了，對吧？朋友就應該互相支持生意，您不覺得嗎？

lines.en: Friends? Well... I like you, Kai, but this is a business decision.
lines.zh: 朋友？嗯……我是很喜歡你，凱，但這是商業決定。

story.en: Ms. Novak raises an eyebrow and writes "no business case" next to your name.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士挑起眉毛，在你的名字旁邊寫下「沒有商業理由」。

fail.why: 在台灣打「交情牌」有時有用，但在西方商務場合，決策主要看成本與效益，靠關係拜託反而顯得沒有說服力。用總成本來比較：The total cost is lower.。

choices.en: If you want cheap and bad lights, sure, go ahead and stay with them. It's your choice.
choices.zh: 如果你們想要便宜又爛的燈，當然，就繼續用他們吧。這是你們的選擇。

lines.zh: 哇。好喔。也許我們真的會。

story.en: Your sarcasm lands like a cold espresso. Mr. Reyes suddenly remembers another meeting.
story.zh: 你的酸言酸語像一杯冷掉的濃縮咖啡。雷耶斯先生突然想起還有另一個會要開。

fail.why: 用嘲諷的語氣回應客戶的比較，等於把客戶推向競爭對手。冷靜說明差異：That's certainly an option. The difference is...。

lines.en: All right. Send me a full cost breakdown by Friday, and we'll talk again.
lines.zh: 好吧。週五前寄一份完整的成本明細給我，我們再談。

choices.en: Absolutely. I'll send it by Thursday, so you'll have a day to look it over.
choices.zh: 沒問題。我週四前就寄給您，讓您有一天時間細看。
choices.tip: 比對方要求的期限更早交件，是建立信任最簡單的方法。

choices.en: Sure. I will sending you the breakdown before Friday, and then we can discuss about it again.
choices.zh: 好的。我會在週五前寄明細給您，然後我們再討論。

lines.en: Fine. Please make sure the breakdown itself is very clear.
lines.zh: 好。請務必確保明細本身寫得很清楚。

story.en: Ms. Novak now plans to read your breakdown with a red pen. Every line of it.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士現在打算拿紅筆看你的明細，一行都不放過。

fail.why: will 後面接原形動詞 send，不是 sending；discuss 本身就是及物動詞，不加 about。說成 I'll send it by Thursday. 就簡潔有力。

choices.en: Friday? Can't we just decide today? I have to report the result to my manager tonight, you see.
choices.zh: 週五？我們不能今天就決定嗎？我今晚得向主管報告結果。

lines.en: Your reporting schedule is not my problem. Friday stands.
lines.zh: 你的報告時程不是我的問題。就是週五。

story.en: You go back to the office empty-handed, and Ms. Wong asks why the client should care about your report.
story.zh: 你兩手空空回到公司，王經理問你：客戶為什麼要在意你的報告？

fail.why: 拿自己的內部壓力催客戶決定，會讓對方覺得你只在乎業績。配合客戶的節奏，甚至提早交件：I'll send it by Thursday.。

lines.en: Thursday. I like that. You handled my questions well, Kai.
lines.zh: 週四，我喜歡。你回答我的問題回答得很好，凱。

lines.en: Coming from Ms. Novak, that's practically a standing ovation.
lines.zh: 能讓諾瓦克女士這樣說，簡直等於起立鼓掌了。

story.en: The price did not change, but the conversation did. You leave with a deadline, a nod from the finance director, and a deal still very much alive.
story.zh: 價格沒變，但談話的方向變了。你帶著一個期限、財務總監的認可，以及仍然熱騰騰的生意離開。

notes.explain: 處理異議的第一步：先承認對方的感受，不急著反駁。接著再說 May I show you...? 引導到價值。

example.en: I understand your concern. Let me explain how the pricing works.
example.zh: 我理解您的顧慮。讓我說明一下價格是怎麼算的。

notes.en: Let's look at the long-term savings.
notes.zh: 我們來看看長期能省下的費用。
notes.explain: 客戶嫌貴時，把焦點從一次性的價格轉到長期效益。搭配 pays for itself（回本）更有說服力。

example.en: Let's look at the long-term savings over five years.
example.zh: 我們來看看五年下來的長期節省。

notes.explain: 形容一項投資省下的錢足以抵銷成本。主詞是產品，例如 The system pays for itself in two years.。

example.en: These lights pay for themselves in about eighteen months.
example.zh: 這些燈大約十八個月就能回本。

notes.explain: 直接否定客戶的感受，很容易變成爭論。說 Fair point. 或 That makes sense. 先認同，再提出數據。

example.en: Fair point. Here are the numbers from your trial cafe.
example.zh: 您說得對。這是您試用分店的數據。

notes.explain: 西方商務決策重視成本與證據，「給個面子」「我們是朋友」這類說法不但難懂，還會削弱你的說服力。

example.en: I'd be happy to share the data so you can check it yourself.
example.zh: 我很樂意提供數據，讓您自己核對。
